## Design Taste
*Source: https://luma.com/cursor-bkk-090826 — generated by /taste*

### Tokens
- **Colors**: background `#F2F2F2` (fills ~93% of surface), surface `#FFFFFF`, text-primary `#141414`, text-muted `rgba(20,20,20,0.64)`, text-subtle `rgba(20,20,20,0.36)`, accent `#D69712` (amber — <1% of surface, one signal only)
- **Type**: h1 `Google Sans Flex` 48px/575; everything else `-apple-system` — body 16px/400 (24px line-height), ui 14px/500, meta 13px/400, caption 12px/400
- **Radius**: 8px buttons, 24px cards/cover, 100px & 1000px pills/avatars, 4px small
- **Shadows**: hairline `rgba(20,20,20,0.08) 0 0 0 0.5px inset` (default separator); `rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0 1px 4px` (reserved for the single most important card)
- **Spacing**: 4px base; dominant 8px; 18px paragraph beat; flexbox `gap`+`margin`, no CSS grid
- **Layout**: two-column, container 1600px, `body padding 0`, `max-width: none`
- **Motion**: `all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)`; `:focus-visible` present; `prefers-reduced-motion` respected

### Directives
- When separating unlike blocks on one screen, always use a flat grey field with 0.5px inset hairlines over elevated drop-shadowed cards — a near-invisible edge marks a distinct thing without a glow around every block, so the one true drop shadow can mark the widget that matters.
- When spending the accent, always confine amber `#D69712` to a single meaning and paint the primary CTA neutral `#141414` — if everything interactive is colored, color stops carrying information.
- When choosing typefaces, always load one web font for the h1 only and render body/UI/multilingual text in the native `-apple-system` stack — one branded headline buys identity while the page paints instantly and reads like the visitor's own OS.
- When laying out read-only prose, always separate it with whitespace and hairline header rules rather than wrapping each sub-section in a card — cards signal "act on me," so reserve them for genuinely actionable content.

### Anti-patterns
- Never wrap read-only text sub-sections in cards; cards are for actionable content only (only 2 cards on the source page — cover + registration — both actionable).
- Never color the primary CTA with the brand accent; keep it neutral `#141414` and spend accent on one status signal.
- Never use drop shadows as the default separator; default to the 0.5px inset hairline and reserve `0 1px 4px` for one element.
- Never load a web font for body copy; `-apple-system` carries 271 uses on the source page, the web font just 8 (h1 only).
